spec_says.text: FlushManager performs a final flush on Drop (graceful shutdown); recommended trigger move || flush_manager.trigger_flush()

code_does.text: component -> flush_trigger -> FlushManager -> worker thread -> callbacks holding Arc<component>: reference cycle; Drop never runs, no final flush, worker thread leaks; no detach API

proposals.resolution: Recommended: add ExtendedMetadataStoreComponent::detach_flush_trigger() -> Option<FlushTrigger>; wiring layer MUST detach before shutdown so Drop runs while the component is alive; update repair test; add test attach/put/detach+drop/reboot/get. Alternative (Weak callbacks) needs a no-component sentinel in do_flush to avoid writing an empty region on the final pass.
